newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks gain, bolstered by futures expiry.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks gain, bolstered by futures expiry.

text.p: Madrid stocks were higher at midsession on Friday in heavy volume fuelled by today's June Ibex futures expiry, dealers said.
At noon the general index was up 4.49 points, 0.77 percent, to 487.01. At 1100 GMT, the Ibex-35 was up 58.65 points, 0.88 percent, to 6,733.42.

"Trade is very influenced by the futures expiry and we've heard that there's an investor with a big call influencing the market. There's always a tendency for volatility when this happens, there's a lot of crosses and a lot of manipulation," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
BBV gained 130 pesetas to 11,490 after a strong reception for 5-month profit figures given on Thursday, dealers said.
